summary: Full end-to-end backend + frontend testing of Sistem Pemesanan Rumah & CRM Rumah KORPRI. All 23 pytest backend tests pass (auth/register/login for 4 roles, public projects & KPR simulate, full booking->payment->SPR issue->KPR app auto-create->doc upload->verify->WA followup->BTN decision->notifications->stats->role RBAC). UI tested with Playwright: landing loads, all 4 dashboards (consumer portal, KORPRI CRM, Developer, BTN) render correctly with seeded data; consumer end-to-end flow (login -> project detail with interactive KPR simulator -> book unit -> QRIS modal -> confirm payment -> Draft SPR appears in portal) works without errors. Toasts, badges, doc checklist, KPR sim installment computation all render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py updates password_hash on every startup for existing seeded users - fine for demo but note that any manual admin password change would be overwritten by the OWNER_PASSWORD env on restart.
GET /api/bookings/{id}/spr.pdf has no auth guard - anyone with the booking id can download the SPR PDF. Consider adding auth check similar to get_booking.
POST /api/payments/webhook has no signature/secret validation (acceptable since flagged as SIMULATED, but note for production).
server.py is ~520 lines; consider splitting bookings/documents/kpr/notification routers into separate modules for maintainability.
